raw_prompt: !fix the tnt-bow all I want is very simple. Just wait a few ticks after spawning each so that they all explode at different times
reviewer_feedback: Updated the TNT Bow to spawn TNT projectiles with a 5-tick delay to ensure staggered explosion times.
usage_instructions: Use /give-tnt-bow to receive the custom TNT Bow.
Shoot the bow to trigger a cascade of TNT at the impact point.

mutations.content:
on shoot:
    if shooter is a player:
        if name of shooter's tool is "&cTNT Bow":
            set {_uuid} to uuid of projectile
            set {tnt_arrow::%{_uuid}%} to true

on projectile hit:
    if {tnt_arrow::%uuid of projectile%} is true:
        delete {tnt_arrow::%uuid of projectile%}
        set {_loc} to location of projectile
        loop 10 times:
            spawn 1 primed tnt at {_loc}
            set velocity of last spawned tnt to vector(random number between -0.5 and 0.5, 0.5, random number between -0.5 and 0.5)
            wait 5 ticks
        delete projectile

command /give-tnt-bow:
    permission: op
    trigger:
        give player a bow named "&cTNT Bow" with lore "&7Shoots cascading TNT explosions."

traces.intent_summary: Add a delay between TNT projectile spawns to ensure staggered explosions.

traces.rationale: Replaced metadata (which is unreliable for projectiles) with a UUID-based variable map to track arrows. Changed the loop to spawn one TNT at a time with a 5-tick delay between each, ensuring they have staggered fuse times and spread out properly.

traces.user_summary: Updated the TNT Bow to spawn TNT projectiles with a 5-tick delay to ensure staggered explosion times.
usage_instructions: Use /give-tnt-bow to receive the custom TNT Bow.
Shoot the bow to trigger a cascade of TNT at the impact point.
